postings.title: Account Executive
postings.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
The Role

We are currently seeking an Account Executive to join our Sales Team! We are looking for a superstar to add to our ever-expanding team. We are seeking an experienced, quota-carrying sales performer who is looking to help grow Addepar to be the financial platform for the Finance Industry. The Account Executive will be responsible for growing new ARR for large RIAs’, Multi-Family Offices and Private Banks. 

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and execute a territory plan to identify, qualify, and close new business within a named account list of RIAs, Family Offices, and Multi-Family offices (up to $1.5B in Assets under management)

- Own the full sales cycle on deals from initial outreach and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close

- Aggressively prospect and build a pipeline through outbound outreach, referrals, events, and inbound lead follow-up

- Conduct compelling product demonstrations that connect Addepar’s platform capabilities to each prospect’s specific operational challenges

- Engage decision-makers at the VP and C-suite level, including COOs, CTOs, and firm principals

- Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecast in Salesforce, with consistent hygiene and timely updates

- Partner with Pre-sales and Client Success to engage smooth handoffs and a strong client experience through onboarding 

- Represent Addepar at industry events, conferences, and prospect meetings (40-50% travel expected)

Who You Are

- 4+years of experience in software or SaaS sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota

- Experience selling into the wealth management or financial services industry, with familiarity with RIA and family office business models

- Proven ability to run a structured sales process end-to-end, including discovery, demo, and close

- Comfortable engaging VP and C-suite stakeholders in financial services firms

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce for pipeline and activity management

- Strong presentation and communication skills, both written and verbal

- Proficiency with web conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, etc.)

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

- Bachelor’s degree 

You will Also Bring

- Intellectual curiosity about fintech and wealth management - you want to understand the industry, not just sell into it

- Coachability and a growth mindset; you actively seek feedback and apply it

- A competitive drive balanced with a collaborative, team-first attitude

- Strong organizational skills and the discipline to manage a high-volume pipeline

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.
Base Salary Range
$108,000—$135,000 USD

Our Values 

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

- Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 

- Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

- Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 

- Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

We are seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to join our growing global accounting team. This role will oversee accounting operations across the EMEA region, support the monthly and quarterly close processes, and partner closely with the Global Controller and cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP and local statutory requirements.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical accounting expertise, international accounting experience, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced global environment.

What You’ll Do

- Oversee the month-end and quarter-end close processes for the EMEA region, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial reporting.

- Perform variance analysis and provide insights into financial results and operational performance to support management decision-making.

- Manage the overall accounting operations for assigned EMEA entities, including maintaining strong internal controls, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, and analyzing financial performance.

- Oversee and manage intercompany accounting and reconciliation processes across global entities.

- Review and supervise the work of accounting staff, providing coaching, guidance, and development support.

- Oversee payroll accounting and related processes across the EMEA region.

- Partner with external auditors and local advisors to support statutory audits and ensure timely resolution of audit requests and findings.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance efficiency, and strengthen accounting operations as the organization continues to scale.

- Support special projects and strategic initiatives led by senior management.

- Assist with the setup and operational readiness of new international office locations and legal entities.

- Analyze and reconcile foreign exchange impacts across balance sheet and P&L accounts to ensure financial results are reasonable and accurately reported.

Who You Are 

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- Several years of progressive accounting experience, preferably within multinational or high-growth environments.

- ACA, ACCA, CA (ICAS), or CIMA qualified, or hold an equivalent recognised professional accounting qualification.

- Experience managing international accounting operations and working with foreign statutory requirements.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to prioritize effectively, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

- Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite and advanced Excel skills.

- Prior people management experience with the ability to lead and develop team members.

- Experience working with multinational entities, intercompany accounting, FX accounting, and payroll operations is a plus.

Being a part of the AddeGrad Program, you will be working on meaningful projects that you can feel proud of while building your career for future advancement. In addition to having a supportive manager and collaborative teams, we provide an in-depth onboarding and enablement program to get you acclimated and ready for each path of your career growth journey in the program. A strong corporate culture and cool swag are also included!

This 18-month step program will provide exposure to key functions of the Client Services team and in-depth knowledge of the Addepar platform - integral to unlocking further career growth and development within the company. You’ll have the ability to partner with key stakeholders across our Go-To-Market and R&D teams. Upon completion of the program, you’ll be prepared to continue growing your career in other parts of the business, such as Client Success, or continue within Client Services. We are currently seeking a Client Solutions Analyst to join our Services Team! Client Solutions Analysts are responsible for designing and implementing Addepar for new clients. They are passionate about identifying how Addepar can unlock significant value for clients’ businesses and regularly call upon their analytical and consulting skills in order to advise clients on how to model and examine their financial instruments and assets. Client Solutions Analysts have a deep understanding of both finance and technology and take ownership of clients’ success.

Our ideal candidate has a strong desire to provide an outstanding client experience directly in investment management or in software deployments of a related domain; they are expected to display a strong sense of self-reliance as well as the ability to collaborate with other Addepar resources within our Sales, Product, and Partnership organizations. They must have a deep understanding of our target markets (or a hunger and willingness to learn). Ideal candidates are passionate about understanding our client's needs and taking a hands-on approach to solving problems.

In this role, you will lead the design and oversight for new clients onboarding to the Addepar platform, ensuring that we’re developing the best solutions to fit their unique and complex requirements. Additionally, you will be responsible for ensuring that the solutions we develop for our clients are compatible with the other products and services within the Addepar ecosystem as our offering continues to expand.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining a post-graduate cohort, growing and developing your career in an 18-month program with direct exposure and access to our most valuable asset - our clients.

You will begin your journey on the Client Support team where you'll gain in-depth product knowledge as you become an Addepar platform expert working to:

- Provide hands-on support to identify, respond to, and resolve issues and questions raised by Addepar’s clients

- Work in complex data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies

- Collaborate with R&D teams to conduct root-cause analysis; Product and Account Management to manage and maintain client satisfaction.

- Help clients use Addepar to the greatest extent through both functional and conceptual instruction

In future rotations, you’ll shift your focus towards other roles within the Services organization to:

- Learn how to design solutions and execute project implementations

- Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction

- Prioritize and context-switch effectively to support simultaneous projects

- Identify and drive opportunities to improve our current processes and standard methodologies as the Addepar platform continues to rapidly expand

- Connect with clients in a proactive, consultative, and professional manner

- Effectively communicate project health and status to internal and external senior leadership.

Who You Are

- BA/BS in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field with graduation dates between Fall 2026 - Spring 2027. Minors in Computer Science, Data Science, or related fields are nice-to-have but not required. 

- Exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills

- Solution-oriented approach and a passion for problem-solving

- Proven ability to research, design, and implement solutions for complex problems

- Independent, adaptable, and can thrive in a fast-paced environment

- Strong desire to gain further understanding of the global wealth management business

- Effective communication and interpersonal skills (both written and verbal)

- Strong work ethic, proactive and a highly contributing teammate

- Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret

- Prior internship experience working in finance, technology, and/or consulting is a plus

- Experience programming in Python language and/or experience with project management is a plus

A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

$85,000—$85,000 USD

- Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 

- Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.

postings.title: ADM Support Analyst
postings.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
The Role

The ADM Support team handles all client inquiries related to Addepar's Alternatives Data Management (ADM) solution post-implementation. ADM Support Analysts play a critical role in supporting some of the world's most sophisticated investors, answering questions and resolving issues related to their alternative investment data on the Addepar platform. They ensure clients get the most value out of each interaction by providing accurate, timely guidance across the full scope of ADM functionality.

Our ideal candidate is tenacious about tackling problems, can skillfully coordinate with internal teams, and enjoys working directly with clients in the alternative investments space.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

- Identify, respond to, and resolve issues and questions raised by ADM clients, providing timely and accurate support.

- Work in complex alternative investment data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies.

- Evaluate the criticality of client issues and collaborate with other internal ADM teams (Collections, Operations) to drive resolution.

- Conduct root-cause analysis in partnership with Engineering and Data teams to resolve issues.

- Help clients leverage the ADM platform to the greatest extent possible through both functional and conceptual instruction.

- Prioritise and context-switch effectively to execute on simultaneous cases, seeing each through to the finish line.

- Contribute to improving team processes and documentation as we scale and deliver on ADM.

- Develop deep expertise in Addepar's ADM solution and the broader alternative investments landscape.

Who You Are

- Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.

- 1+ years of relevant experience in a client-facing role, ideally within financial services or investment management.

- Strong communication, organisational, and time-management skills.

- Proficiency in maths and comfort working in complex data sets.

- Passion for problem-solving and continuous learning.

- Passion for technology and finance.

- [Plus] Previous experience in investment management, particularly alternative investments.

- [Plus] Familiarity with alternative investment data and its operational nuances.

- [Plus] Experience using or supporting the Addepar platform.

- Keep Salesforce and Jira records (contacts, accounts, NDA status, profile share and access data, request status) accurate and audit-ready.

- Report on Assurance and Deal Desk volume, turnaround time and bottlenecks, and take initiative to design, document and continuously improve repeatable processes, leading small-to-medium process improvement and automation projects with limited guidance.

- Hands-on experience with Jira and Salesforce (or another CRM) to manage queues, workflows and records.

- Able to work effectively with cross-functional leaders in ISR, Legal, Compliance, Product and other teams, translating between business, security and legal needs and building consensus without direct authority.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining policy and process to sales and client stakeholders.

- Sound judgment on when to apply the rules and when to escalate; able to work with little supervision.

- Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases

- Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations

- Familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions

- Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios

This role is responsible for expanding our continuing to drive growth and pipeline success of the Single Family Office (SFO) segment at Addepar through data-driven performance marketing strategies and highly targeted acquisition campaigns. As the owner of the SFO performance marketing motion, you will build, scale, and manage multi-channel demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) efforts specifically tailored to this highly sophisticated audience.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in B2B performance marketing, deep experience in the wealth management, family office, or financial technology industries, and a proven track record of developing a robust pipeline of high-value opportunities. - Excellent communication skills and the ability to build interpersonal connections with internal sales collaborators and external stakeholders.

- Creative problem solver with a strategic perspective and a data-driven approach.

You will be directly responsible for building, configuring, and maintaining Pigment items (such as blocks, metrics, transactions, applications, and dashboards) to streamline our budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes. You will design, build, and deploy multidimensional applications, metrics, transaction lists, and executive dashboards in Pigment to replace offline spreadsheets and disconnected legacy tools. The ideal candidate pairs strong FP&A and accounting principles with hands-on systems architecture skills to bridge the gap between financial strategy and technological implementation.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

Pigment Development & System Architecture

- Model Building: Design, build, and configure multidimensional models, metrics, dimension lists, and transaction blocks to support budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning.

- Item & Workflow Design: Create clean, scalable items (data views, metrics, calculated properties, line items) within Pigment to automate complex financial schedules (e.g., headcount planning, revenue recognition, capex, working capital).

- Integration & Maintenance: Collaborate with IT and Data Teams to maintain integrations between Pigment, ERP systems, CRM and other planning systems.

- Optimization: Audit existing Pigment architecture to improve calculation performance, simplify complexity, and maintain model scalability.

Financial Analysis & Business Partnering

- Financial Modeling: Translate complex business rules, accounting guidelines, and FP&A models into efficient formula logic.

- Variance & Driver Analysis: Build real-time variance analysis dashboards (Actual vs. Budget vs. Forecast) to enable fast business decision-making.

- Process Standardisation: Partner with FP&A stakeholders to standardize data structures, chart of accounts (COA) mappings, and driver assumptions across business units.

- Reporting & Dashboards: Design intuitive end-user dashboards and reporting packages within Pigment for executive leadership and department heads.

Who You Are 

Technical Skills

- Pigment Expertise: Proven hands-on experience building, modeling, and configuring items within Pigment (or equivalent Anaplan / Adaptive Planning / Jedox platforms with a track record of transitioning to Pigment).

- FP&A / Accounting Core: Strong understanding of financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow), US GAAP principles, variance reporting, and corporate FP&A workflows.

- Data & Excel Skills: Advanced proficiency in financial formula structures, relational data structures, multidimensional modeling concepts (dimensions, cubes, properties), and basic SQL or data transformation logic.

Professional Background

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.

- Experience: 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Financial Modeling, or Financial Systems Administration (with direct experience building in cloud EPM/CPM platforms).

- Communication: Ability to translate complex finance requirements into technical model logic and explain system capabilities to non-technical business partners.

Key Competencies & Behaviors

- Architect Mindset: Thinks holistically about how individual metrics and data blocks interconnect across applications.

- Data Hygiene: Strong focus on data integrity, governance, and auditability within model structures.

- Problem Solver: Enjoys troubleshooting formula logic, identifying model bottlenecks, and optimizing workflows.

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. - Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)

- Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

- Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)

- Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

- You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.

Addepar’s Enterprise Sales team partners with some of the largest wealth management firms in the globally, including many listed on the Barron’s Top 40.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will lead complex, consultative sales efforts with a small set of highly strategic clients. This is a senior role with responsibility for both driving new business and expanding long-term partnerships across global financial institutions.

You will act as the business owner for your accounts, setting strategy, leading execution, and aligning internal teams to deliver meaningful outcomes for clients. This role goes beyond traditional sales; you’ll help shape how leading firms evolve their advisor and client experience through technology.

You’ll operate in a highly cross-functional environment, partnering with teams across Sales Engineering, Client Success, Services, Partnerships, Marketing, and R&D to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience from initial engagement through long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

- Own and grow strategic relationships - Build, expand, and deepen relationships with key enterprise clients. Drive new business, renewals, and multi-year expansion opportunities across your portfolio.

- Lead consultative enterprise sales cycles - Own complex, multi-stakeholder deals across large financial institutions, often spanning regions, business lines, and senior decision-makers.

- Set account strategy and drive execution - Develop and execute thoughtful, multi-year account plans aligned to client priorities and Addepar’s broader GTM strategy.

- Operate as a cross-functional leader - Work closely with Sales Engineering, Client Success, Services, and Partnerships to deliver a coordinated, “one team” experience—minimizing friction and maximizing client impact.

- Engage at the executive level - Build trusted relationships with C-level stakeholders within client organizations and partner with Addepar’s leadership team when appropriate to advance strategic opportunities.

- Contribute to how we go to market - Bring perspective from your experience and from the field—sharing best practices, shaping engagement models, and helping evolve how we serve enterprise clients.

- Maintain strong pipeline and forecasting discipline - Ensure timely, accurate pipeline management and forecasting to support internal alignment and planning.

Who You Are 

- Proven enterprise seller - You bring significant experience leading complex SaaS or platform sales cycles, ideally within wealth management or financial services.

- Client-focused and outcomes-driven- You have a track record of building long-term relationships and delivering meaningful results for clients.

- Strategic and consultative - You know how to navigate large organizations, ask the right questions, and align solutions to broader business objectives.

- Executive communicator - You’re comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and can clearly articulate complex ideas in a way that resonates.

- Collaborative by nature - You work well across teams and understand how to bring the right people together to move deals forward and support clients over time.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Security Operations to lead our Global Security Operations team within Addepar’s Information Security & Risk organization. In this role, you will own the day-to-day running of our detection and response function, act as incident commander for security incidents, and partner with our 24/7 MSSP to ensure threats are identified and handled quickly. You will set the operational objectives and strategy for Security Operations, lead and grow a global team, and shape our detection strategy for threats specific to Addepar’s environment. Beyond the immediate response, you will make sure we learn from every incident by driving post-incident follow-through, turning incident trends into lasting fixes with partners across the business, and reporting on the health of the program to Security leadership. We also want this leader to modernize how Security Operations works, applying AI and automation (AIOps) to speed up triage, investigation and response so the team can focus on the highest-impact work. The successful candidate is a hands-on leader who brings structure, calm and accountability to high-pressure situations.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

Ability to work core business hours in Eastern Time (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) if working remotely.

What You’ll Do

- Operational Leadership: Lead the day-to-day operations of Addepar’s Global Security Operations team, and serve as incident commander for major security incidents

- People Management: Manage and develop a globally distributed team. Provide mentorship and training, set the team’s roadmap and OKRs, and manage on-call coverage across time zones

- MSSP Partnership: Own the relationship with our 24/7 Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP), including escalation paths, service quality, vendor performance and cost, and handoffs to the internal team

- Detection & SIEM: Own our detection strategy and the health of our SIEM environment. This includes building custom detections for threats unique to Addepar, tuning alerts to improve fidelity and reduce noise, expanding log source coverage, and ensuring the platform scales as Addepar grows

- AI-Driven Modernization: Lead the modernization of our SecOps function through AIOps, using AI and automation to streamline alert triage, enrichment, investigation and response, reduce manual toil, and scale the team’s impact

- Documentation & Playbooks: Build and own our incident response documentation, including playbooks, runbooks and training materials, and keep it current as threats and our environment evolve

- Post-Incident Accountability: Maintain our post-incident process so action items are clearly owned, tracked and closed across teams, covering both immediate fixes and longer-term improvements

- Root Cause Remediation: Use incident trends to identify recurring root causes, and partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security and Product teams to prioritize and deliver preventive fixes

- Metrics, KPIs & Reporting: Define and track key SecOps metrics and KPIs, and present a holistic monthly view of the Security Operations function to senior leadership

- Security Awareness: Champion security awareness across the company through tabletop exercises, training sessions and talks

- On-Call: Participate in a global on-call rotation, including responding to critical security events outside of standard working hours

- Ability to work core business hours in Eastern Time (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) if working remotely.

- You have proven experience as an incident commander for security incidents: leading the response, coordinating multiple workstreams, running postmortems and driving action items to completion

- You have hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including investigating and responding to security events in the cloud

- You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or a related field, or have equivalent experience

postings.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
postings.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production

- Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflows

- Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specific

- Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality

- Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product features

- Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)

- Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

- Extensive professional software engineering experience

- Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)

- Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs

- Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflows

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)

- You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.

- A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.

- You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

- Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)

- Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)

- Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)

- Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deployments

- Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

postings.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Full Stack (EDI)
postings.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
The Role

The Workflow Platform team builds Addepar's orchestration layer: a platform, on top of Temporal, that lets other Addepar teams turn long-running, multi-step business processes (approvals, data operations, reporting, client notifications) into reliable, observable, human-in-the-loop workflows. As part of the platform offering we own: Task Centre, where users act on the work workflows assign to them; the Executions view, where teams monitor and manage running workflows; and Client Notifications.

We're adding a senior full-stack engineer in Edinburgh. To begin with you'll mostly work on the user-facing side of the platform, and you'll also work on the services behind it. Our engineers work across the stack and in more than one language. Whichever side is newer to you, we'll give you real work there and the support to grow into it. You'll be given high-impact projects to lead end to end, such as a new Task Centre surface, the Executions view, or the components product teams use to build their own task types. You'll work closely with Product and Design to shape what we build, and with our Staff-level tech lead on how we build it, alongside colleagues in Pune and the US and the product teams building on the platform.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

- Own the design and delivery of a defined area of the platform end to end, from interface to API: write the design, break it into deliverable slices, ship it and support it in production.

- Build user-facing features in React and TypeScript that make complex, long-running workflows clear and actionable for the people working in them.

- Work on the services behind those experiences (Python and Java APIs and workflow workers), and shape API contracts so the front end and back end evolve together.

- Make the platform easier for other teams to build on: reusable UI components and patterns, clear contracts, and documentation that lets them self-serve.

- Spot gaps and opportunities in your area and act on them without waiting for direction.

- Write RFCs for your area, present them at our weekly Architecture Working Group, and contribute to design reviews of others' work.

- Share in running what we build: observability, debugging live issues, incident response and our on-call rotation.

- Share what you know with less-experienced engineers through code review, pairing and design discussion.

- Help the team use AI-assisted development effectively and responsibly.

Who You Are

- Extensive software engineering experience, much of it building web front ends, with a track record of taking features from design to production.

- Strong in TypeScript and a modern component framework (we use React), including state management, data fetching and testing UI code.

- Has worked on the backend of products they've built (APIs, data models, services) in any language, and wants to do more of it.

- Cares about usability and accessibility. Can turn a rough requirement into an interface people can use without a manual, with or without a finished design.

- Designs UIs for systems that are slow, asynchronous or failing: loading, partial and error states, retries and stale data.

- Makes and owns decisions in their area, including when established processes don't fully fit.

- Finds and closes gaps in their area without waiting to be told.

- Collaborates across teams without a manager driving alignment, and uses clear reasoning and evidence to influence decisions in their area.
